device.name: Belkin Wemo Mini Smart Plug
device.notes:
Belkin Wemo Mini Smart Plug (model F7C063) and the closely related Wemo WiFi Smart Plug V2 (WSP080). Controlled locally over UPnP: SSDP discovery then SOAP 1.1 action calls — no cloud required for on/off or state, so the device keeps working after the announced Wemo cloud shutdown (2026-01-31). The same protocol covers the wider Wemo family (Insight Switch, Light Switch, Dimmer, Bridge) which differ by UPnP deviceType and service list.

DISCOVERY (SSDP / UPnP — NOT mDNS): send an HTTP-over-UDP M-SEARCH to the multicast group 239.255.255.250:1900 with MAN "ssdp:discover", MX 1, and ST `urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1` (alternates that also match: `ssdp:all` and `urn:Belkin:device:controllee:1`). The unicast reply's LOCATION header gives `http://<ip>:<port>/setup.xml`; the USN looks like `uuid:Socket-1_0-<serial>::urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1`. GET that LOCATION to read the device description (deviceType, friendlyName, UDN, serialNumber, macAddress, modelName/modelNumber, serviceList).

PORT INSTABILITY: the HTTP port is not fixed. pywemo PROBE_PORTS tries 49153 first, then 49152, 49154, 49151, 49155, 49156, 49157, 49158, 49159. A client must re-probe after the device reconnects / changes IP, since the port can move within that range.

CONTROL: SOAP 1.1 POST. Required headers are `Content-Type: text/xml; charset="utf-8"` and `SOAPACTION: "<serviceType>#<Action>"` — e.g. `"urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1#SetBinaryState"`. The SOAP body carries the matching service-type XML namespace. SetBinaryState sends BinaryState=1 (on) / 0 (off); GetBinaryState reads current state; GetInsightParams returns power/energy telemetry on Insight models. Asynchronous state changes are delivered via UPnP eventing (SUBSCRIBE to each service's eventSubURL, e.g. /upnp/event/basicevent1).

SETUP / PROVISIONING: a factory-reset device broadcasts a WiFi AP with SSID prefix `WeMo.Setup.`; the app joins it and provisions home WiFi via the same SOAP surface (pywemo api/wifi_setup.py — GetApList, ConnectHomeNetwork).

HYBRID CLOUD (from APK, for reference only — not used by a local-only client): remote/account features talk to `api.xwemo.com:8443` / `appapis.xwemo.com:8443`, Firebase (`productionwemoandroidpn.firebaseio.com`) for push, and AWS IoT. These are the services affected by the shutdown.

── SCHEMA GAPS (schema.json NOT modified; see header comment for detail) ── (a) No `identification` field for the SSDP multicast target 239.255.255.250:1900, the M-SEARCH ST URN `urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1`, or the UPnP deviceType `urn:Belkin:device:controllee:1`; documented here + in /setup.xml. (b) `default_port` is a single integer but the port drifts 49152-49159 (probe 49153 first, re-probe after reconnect); a probe-list array would fit better. (c) `http_endpoints` has no `headers` field, so the required SOAPACTION header and service-type XML namespace live in each endpoint's `description`; SetBinaryState and GetBinaryState share one path and are disambiguated only by SOAPACTION.

http_endpoints.description: UPnP device description document, fetched from the LOCATION header returned by SSDP discovery (http://<ip>:<port>/setup.xml). No SOAPACTION header. Identifies the device and enumerates its services/controlURLs. deviceType is `urn:Belkin:device:controllee:1` for the Mini plug (others: :insight:1, :dimmer:1, :lightswitch:1, :bridge:1).
http_endpoints.name: UPnP Device Description

fields.description: Model name, e.g. Socket (Mini F7C063 / WSP080).
fields.name: modelName

fields.description: Model number, e.g. F7C063 (Mini) or WSP080 (V2).
fields.name: modelNumber

fields.description: UPnP services with their controlURL / eventSubURL (basicevent, metainfo, insight).
fields.name: serviceList

http_endpoints.description: SOAP 1.1 action on the basicevent service (controlURL /upnp/control/basicevent1, eventSubURL /upnp/event/basicevent1). REQUIRED header (schema gap (c), no headers field): SOAPACTION: "urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1#SetBinaryState". Content-Type: text/xml; charset="utf-8". The SOAP body uses the `urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1` namespace and sets BinaryState. Shares this path with GetBinaryState — disambiguated ONLY by SOAPACTION.
http_endpoints.name: SetBinaryState (switch on/off)

fields.description: Resulting state echoed by the device (may be 'Error' on failure).
fields.name: BinaryState

http_endpoints.description: SOAP 1.1 action on the basicevent service. REQUIRED header (schema gap (c)): SOAPACTION: "urn:Belkin:service:basicevent:1#GetBinaryState". Content-Type: text/xml; charset="utf-8". Returns the current relay state. Shares the /upnp/control/basicevent1 path with SetBinaryState; the two differ ONLY by SOAPACTION header + body, which the schema cannot model as distinct endpoints. Async updates: UPnP SUBSCRIBE to /upnp/event/basicevent1.
http_endpoints.name: GetBinaryState (read on/off)

http_endpoints.description: SOAP 1.1 action on the insight service (controlURL /upnp/control/insight1). Present ONLY on Insight-class devices, NOT on the basic Mini plug (F7C063 / WSP080 have no power metering). REQUIRED header (schema gap (c)): SOAPACTION: "urn:Belkin:service:insight:1#GetInsightParams". Content-Type: text/xml; charset="utf-8". Returns a colon-delimited InsightParams string carrying on/off state, on-for/on-today/on-total seconds, and instantaneous + cumulative power.
http_endpoints.name: GetInsightParams (power/energy — Insight models)
